g.text: Layer 17 / KV head 5 (Q10/11; accepted head); 3 confirmation guidelines

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #485261

g.text: Directions are calibrated per input to the target fixed-query attention-score perturbation RMS.
Coverage: 24/24 complete method-dose cells; 0/1152 blocked evaluations; 0 missing. Evaluations reuse conditions.
Panel A averages only Q10/11 at layer 17. In negative cases, the unedited gold sibling changes through softmax renormalization.
Panel D: baseline-correct to intervention-wrong transitions / all conditions, not only baseline-correct conditions or clinical outcomes.
Shading: 95% source-guideline bootstrap intervals, conditional on the frozen operator; unadjusted exploratory intervals.
Ordinary causal mask and oracle signs; no module-one evaluation or legacy ASTER (2026-10-26) BLIND/REVEAL masks.
Dashed gray: zero-dose baseline. All complete estimates are shown; incomplete cells remain gaps and are counted in the legend.

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #485261

g.text: Only 3 independent guidelines. This diagnostic cannot establish efficacy or population-level equivalence.
